news.title: Investor sentiment improves as stock rises 17%
news.body: After last week's 17% share price gain to ₹244, the stock trades at a trailing P/E ratio of 11.6x. Average forward P/E is 24x in the Real Estate industry in India. Total loss to shareholders of 21% over the past year.

news.title: New minor risk - Market cap size
news.body: The company's market capitalization is less than US$100m. Market cap: ₹9.18b (US$99.5m) This is considered a minor risk. Companies with a small market capitalization are most likely businesses that have not yet released a product to market or are simply a very small company without a wide reach. Either way, risk is elevated with these companies because there is a chance the product may not come to fruition or the company's addressable market or demand may not be as large as expected. In addition, if the company's size is the main factor, it is less likely to have many investors and analysts following it and scrutinizing its performance and outlook. news.title: Whole-Time Director recently bought ₹3.5m worth of stock
news.body: On the 27th of February, Rahul Rajan Thomas bought around 16k shares on-market at roughly ₹221 per share. This transaction amounted to 4.1% of their direct individual holding at the time of the trade. This was the largest purchase by an insider in the last 3 months. This was the only on-market transaction from insiders over the last 12 months.

news.title: Suraj Estate Developers Limited (NSEI:SURAJEST) completed the acquisition of Hally Pacific Private Limited.
news.body:
Suraj Estate Developers Limited (NSEI:SURAJEST) entered into agreement to acquire Hally Pacific Private Limited for approximately INR 300 million on February 20, 2026. A cash consideration of INR 304 million valued at INR 60800 per share will be paid by Suraj Estate Developers Limited. As part of consideration, INR 304 million is paid towards common equity of Hally Pacific Private Limited.

For the period ending March 31, 2025, Hally Pacific Private Limited reported total revenue of INR 1.74 million.

Suraj Estate Developers Limited (NSEI:SURAJEST) completed the acquisition of Hally Pacific Private Limited on February 23, 2026.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹5.44 (vs ₹4.23 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹5.44 (up from ₹4.23 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹1.81b (up 6.9% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹251.5m (up 26% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 14% (up from 12% in 3Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Revenue is forecast to grow 21% p.a. on average during the next 2 years, compared to a 24% growth forecast for the Real Estate industry in India.
